source_hypotheses: H6.1: review utility is localized to cases for which two frozen policies disagree; non-switch errors cannot explain a paired gain
H6.2: without restrictions on target conditional label risk, observed confidence and retraining agreement alone cannot determine the sign of target review utility
H6.3: under a declared uniform conditional-error shift bound epsilon, sign preservation requires a transported expected gain exceeding epsilon times the target switch fraction
H6.4: an independent switch-set lower confidence bound will often refuse to authorize augmentation with limited labeled calibration data, prioritizing evidential safety over average rank improvement
theoretical_status: finite-sample bookkeeping, Bayes value of information, binomial confidence bounds and risk-transport inequalities are derived rather than claimed as novel universal mathematical theorems
historical_data: A06 and R5 case-level evidence was inspected before H6; always retrospective

new_temporal_datasets.features: SUNACTIVITY[t] and lags 1/2/3/6, differences, past rolling means, calendar year sin/cos with cycle length 11
unemp/current and lagged, current inflation, real GDP growth and lags, CPI, treasury bill rate, real interest rate, quarter sin/cos

partition_rule: chronological disjoint: 45% base fitting; 20% error-risk fitting; 10% unlabeled review-threshold calibration; 10% independent labeled policy certification; 15% untouched final evaluation; integer partition lengths rounded down sequentially, residual assigned to heldout
purge_gap: at least 1 target-horizon observation between each partition to prevent overlap of immediately adjacent one-step labels
preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted on base train only; fixed model hyperparameters; no test-label tuning
risk_estimation: supervised L2 logistic error-risk regression trained only on riskfit labels; confidence-only features 1-confidence and reference class; augmented adds disagreement, audit probability std and interaction (1-confidence)*disagreement
policy_certification: one-sided 95% switch-set bound using four simultaneous two-sided Clopper-Pearson intervals with Bonferroni; policies fixed before certification set
safe_deployment_gate: activate augmented policy only if independent certification lower gain bound > 0; otherwise deploy confidence-only
reporting_constraints: all eight new temporal cells, gains and losses, and abstentions
no pooled significance across overlapping resplits
source and test labels may not be used to tune new models after opening
fixed PRNG seeds do not prove independent retraining
certification validity requires IID certification and evaluation observations; temporal data violate exact IID premise
historical A06/R5 numerical results are exploratory and not independent confirmation
